title: Universal Data Workbench
summary: Import CSV and Parquet tables and inspect every column on this device: row counts, source and inferred types with their uncertainty, semantic roles that keep identifiers apart from measures, missing values, values that do not read, unusual values, suspected data errors and corrections that wait for approval, with a log of every conversion. DuckDB 1.5.4 runs in the browser; files never leave the device. A preview: step 1 of 7.
